case_summary.summary: Three low-to-medium severity structural cleanup proposals were accepted: two missing local links were added and one shortcut edge was removed. Two liquid-phase redundancy removals were rejected because the reviewer did not accept redundancy claims across different semantic types.

planning_patterns.proposed_change: Add material-to-pressure link: alkylate -> high pressure.
planning_patterns.matched_rule: Retained condition nodes should be fully integrated with their material-state links.
planning_patterns.few_shot_takeaway: If a condition is kept as part of the scenario, add its missing material-property attachment rather than leaving it structurally isolated.

planning_patterns.proposed_change: Add temperature-to-ignition link: high temperature -> ignition.
planning_patterns.matched_rule: Retained condition nodes should have an explicit downstream role in the local mechanism.
planning_patterns.few_shot_takeaway: When a retained condition lacks pathway function, connect it to the nearest supported downstream event.

planning_patterns.reviewer_reason: don't identify redundancy accross different types
planning_patterns.matched_rule: Do not apply redundancy deletion when the claim depends only on cross-type overlap rather than true duplicate semantics.
planning_patterns.few_shot_takeaway: Do not delete a condition node just because it looks descriptively similar to another node of a different type.

planning_patterns.proposed_change: Delete the material-to-liquid edge because the liquid node was proposed for deletion.
planning_patterns.reviewer_reason: don't identify redundancy accross different types
planning_patterns.matched_rule: Do not remove an edge based on a redundancy claim that is invalid across semantic types.
planning_patterns.few_shot_takeaway: Keep a property edge when the connected condition is still considered valid and the only deletion basis is cross-type redundancy.

planning_patterns.proposed_change: Delete the direct combustibility -> jet fire edge.
planning_patterns.matched_rule: Remove shortcut edges that bypass an explicit intermediate event already representing the mechanism.
planning_patterns.few_shot_takeaway: If an explicit intermediate event already carries the mechanism, delete the direct shortcut edge to the consequence.

diagnosis_patterns.observed_pattern: Retained pressure condition lacked its incoming material-property link.
diagnosis_patterns.diagnosis_interpretation: This was correctly framed as a local completeness issue for a retained condition, not as a node quality problem requiring deletion.
diagnosis_patterns.supporting_rule: Missing local links should be repaired when a retained condition is meaningful to the scenario.
diagnosis_patterns.few_shot_takeaway: Diagnose unattached retained conditions as incomplete local mechanism structure.

diagnosis_patterns.observed_pattern: Retained temperature condition lacked a downstream causal connection.
diagnosis_patterns.diagnosis_interpretation: The issue was appropriately diagnosed as an incomplete mechanism around an otherwise valid condition node.
diagnosis_patterns.supporting_rule: A retained condition should connect to the event stage where it has a supported causal role.
diagnosis_patterns.few_shot_takeaway: When a condition is kept but has no downstream effect, diagnose a missing local causal link.

diagnosis_patterns.observed_pattern: A descriptive condition was kept despite a prior redundant-node diagnosis.
diagnosis_patterns.diagnosis_interpretation: The review implies the redundancy framing was too aggressive because it treated different semantic types as interchangeable duplicates.
diagnosis_patterns.supporting_rule: Do not diagnose redundancy across different semantic types unless there is true duplicate meaning and no distinct role.
diagnosis_patterns.few_shot_takeaway: Do not label a node redundant solely because it overlaps descriptively with a node of another type.

diagnosis_patterns.observed_pattern: The material-to-condition property link was preserved along with the condition.
diagnosis_patterns.diagnosis_interpretation: The review suggests the original redundancy diagnosis should not cascade into edge removal when the retained condition is still considered meaningful.
diagnosis_patterns.supporting_rule: Do not diagnose a supporting edge as redundant when the connected node remains valid and cross-type redundancy is the only basis.
diagnosis_patterns.few_shot_takeaway: Only diagnose a supporting edge as removable when its target node is truly invalid or duplicate.

diagnosis_patterns.observed_pattern: A direct condition-to-consequence link bypassed an explicit ignition step.
diagnosis_patterns.diagnosis_interpretation: This was correctly framed as a shortcut-edge issue because the intermediate event already captured the mechanism.
diagnosis_patterns.supporting_rule: Direct edges that bypass an explicit intermediate mechanism should be diagnosed as shortcut edges.
diagnosis_patterns.few_shot_takeaway: Diagnose direct links that skip represented mechanism steps as shortcut structure, not as needed parallel causation.

coverage_notes: The missing-local-link issue for retained conditions was fully covered by the two accepted edge additions; no node changes were needed for pressure or temperature.
The proposed deletion of the material-to-liquid edge depended on deleting the liquid node; once the node deletion was rejected, keeping the edge was consistent.
The updated graph also introduced a new liquid-to-release edge outside the reviewed planning list, giving the retained liquid-phase node an explicit downstream role after review.
